Basis: Fed H.8, all commercial banks, weekly (week-ending Wednesday), seasonally adjusted, via FRED. EOP basis = the last weekly reading dated on or before quarter-end (the week used is shown under each quarter). Average basis = average of all weekly readings dated in the quarter. YoY = vs the same quarter a year earlier on the same basis; LQA = linked-quarter annualized, compounded: ((Q / prior Q)^4 − 1), on the same basis. QTD = quarter in progress (EOP = latest week available; average = weeks so far).
